exposure: medical treatment (estro-progestins, progestin, or Gonadotropin hormone-releasing hormone-analogues)
cohort: The study included 995 patients with pathologically confirmed endometriosis and/or adenomyosis who underwent laparoscopic hysterectomy without concomitant urological and/or gastroenterological procedures.
finding: Laparoscopic hysterectomy for endometriosis/adenomyosis is associated with non-negligible morbidity (9.3% major complications), where previous surgery for endometriosis and intraoperative complications predict higher risks, while older age and medical treatment at the time of surgery are protective factors.
